title: Volcker Fed shifts to targeting money supply
summary: The Federal Reserve under Paul Volcker lets interest rates soar to break inflation, setting up the 1980–82 recessions.

title: Economic Recovery Tax Act of 1981
summary: Cuts the top income tax rate from 70% to 50% and phases in broad rate cuts and indexing.

title: Tax Reform Act of 1986
summary: Broadens the tax base and lowers rates; top rate falls to 28%.

title: Black Monday stock crash
summary: The Dow falls 22.6% in a single day.

title: Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1990
summary: Bush signs tax increases and spending caps, breaking his "no new taxes" pledge; introduces pay-as-you-go budget rules.

title: Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1993
summary: Raises the top income tax rate to 39.6% and expands the EITC; passed without a single Republican vote.

title: NAFTA takes effect
summary: Free-trade area between the US, Canada and Mexico begins.

title: Welfare reform (PRWORA)
summary: Replaces AFDC with time-limited TANF block grants and adds work requirements.

title: Balanced Budget Act of 1997
summary: Spending restraint, mostly in Medicare, paired with the Taxpayer Relief Act's capital-gains cut and child tax credit.

title: EGTRRA (Bush tax cuts)
summary: Broad income tax rate cuts, phased in and set to expire after 2010.

title: September 11 attacks
summary: Followed by the wars in Afghanistan (2001) and Iraq (2003), largely financed by borrowing.

title: JGTRRA
summary: Accelerates the 2001 rate cuts and cuts taxes on dividends and capital gains.

title: Medicare Part D created
summary: The Medicare Modernization Act adds an unfunded prescription-drug benefit, starting 2006.

title: Lehman Brothers collapses
summary: The financial crisis peaks; the Great Recession deepens.

title: TARP bank rescue (EESA)
summary: Authorizes up to $700 billion to stabilize the financial system.

title: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act
summary: About $800 billion in stimulus: tax cuts, aid to states, infrastructure and safety-net spending.

title: Affordable Care Act signed
summary: Medicaid expansion, subsidized insurance marketplaces and an individual mandate; main coverage provisions start in 2014.

title: Dodd–Frank financial reform
summary: New capital, oversight and consumer-protection rules for banks.

title: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act
summary: Corporate rate cut from 35% to 21% and temporary individual rate cuts.

title: Section 301 tariffs on China begin
summary: First 25% tariffs on $34 billion of Chinese imports; China retaliates and the trade war escalates through 2019.

title: COVID-19 declared a pandemic
summary: Lockdowns push unemployment to 14.8% in April 2020.

title: CARES Act
summary: About $2.2 trillion in relief: stimulus checks, expanded unemployment benefits and the Paycheck Protection Program.

title: American Rescue Plan
summary: About $1.9 trillion in relief, including a temporarily expanded child tax credit.

title: Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act
summary: About $1.2 trillion for roads, bridges, broadband, water and transit.

title: Fed begins raising rates
summary: First of eleven rate hikes over 2022–23 to fight post-pandemic inflation.

title: Inflation Reduction Act
summary: Clean-energy tax credits, Medicare drug-price negotiation and a corporate minimum tax.

title: Broad "reciprocal" tariffs announced
summary: A baseline 10% tariff on most imports plus higher country-specific rates, several later paused or renegotiated.

title: One Big Beautiful Bill Act
summary: Makes the 2017 individual tax cuts permanent, adds new deductions and cuts Medicaid and SNAP spending.
